text: Colombian licence plates are typically **yellow**.
NOTE: Within South America, yellow licence plates are almost exclusively found in Colombia.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞車牌通常是**黃色**的。
註：在南美洲內，黃色車牌幾乎只在哥倫比亞找到。

text: In Generation 3 coverage, a **short thick antenna** is sometimes visible with a black, white or grey car. In Generation 4 coverage, a white or silver car is commonly found.
NOTE: Within the Americas, you can also find the antenna in Mexico, Ecuador and Brazil. However, Colombia is the only country with this antenna on a black Google car.
text_zh: 在第 3 代街景覆蓋中，搭配黑色、白色或灰色汽車時，有時可以看到一個**短而粗的天線**。在第 4 代覆蓋中，通常會找到白色或銀色的汽車。
註：在美洲內，你也可以在墨西哥、厄瓜多與巴西找到該天線。然而，哥倫比亞是唯一在黑色 Google 車上擁有此天線的國家。

text: Signposts in Colombia are made of white metal, and join to form a distinct **cross on the back** of signs.
NOTE: White metal signposts can also be found in Brazil, however these are usually wider.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的指路標誌由白色金屬製成，拼接起來會在標誌**背面形成明顯的十字**。
註：白色金屬指路標誌也可以在巴西找到，但這些通常較寬。

text: Colombia uses two types of kilometre markers: a tall green version with the letters “**Pr**” at the top, and the traditional stone marker with black lettering. Both designs are unique to the country.

NOTE: The first two digits at the bottom indicate the road number. In this case, the road number is 90. The last two digits indicate the section of the road, which increase west to east on even numbered highways, and south to north on odd numbered highways.You can use this [resource](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Carreteras_nacionales_de_Colombia) to help identify each section.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞使用兩種型態的公里標：頂部帶有字母「**Pr**」的高大綠色版本，以及帶有黑色字體的傳統石碑標。這兩種設計都是該國獨有的。
註：底部的頭兩位數表示道路編號。在這種情況下，道路編號是 90。最後兩位數表示道路的路段，在雙號高速公路上由西向東遞增，在單號高速公路上由南向台北遞增。你可以使用這個[資源](https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anexo:Carreteras_nacionales_de_Colombia)來幫助識別每個路段。

text: Colombian poles are often marked with unique **black-and-yellow** or black-and-orange stripes.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的電線桿通常標有獨特的**黑黃相間**或黑橘相間條紋。

text: **Wooden fences** are particularly common in Colombia.
NOTE: In addition to the unpainted variants, some fence posts are [painted and sharp](https://maps.app.goo.gl/z7gpBcspK4rCWeep8) at the top. These are almost exclusive to Colombia.
text_zh: **木造柵欄**在哥倫比亞特別常見。
註：除了未上漆的款式外，有些柵欄柱頂部[有上漆且呈尖銳狀](https://maps.app.goo.gl/z7gpBcspK4rCWeep8)。這些幾乎是哥倫比亞獨有的。

text: Colombian taxis are always this **pastel yellow** colour. As opposed to private vehicles, they have white licence plates, which are often printed on the side and roof. If unblurred, you will often see the city name.
NOTE: Ecuadorian taxis may look similar. However, they use a slightly more saturated yellow and typically have orange plates.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞計程車總是這種**粉嫩黃色**。與私人車輛相反，它們使用白色車牌，通常會印在車身側邊與車頂上。如果沒有模糊，你通常會看到城市名稱。
註：厄瓜多計程車看起來可能很像。然而，它們使用的是飽和度稍高的黃色，且通常使用橘色車牌。

text: Colombian poles are generally **concrete** with a variety of pole tops.
Moreover, dark-coloured poles are more common in Colombia than in neighbouring countries.
NOTE: It is the only country in the Americas, apart from Mexico and Ecuador, where octagonal poles can be found.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的電線桿通常是**混凝土**製成，並搭配各種電線桿頂部。
此外，深色電線桿在哥倫比亞比鄰近國家更常見。
註：它是美洲中除了墨西哥和厄瓜多之外，唯一能找到八角形電線桿的國家。

text: In Colombia, it is particularly common for sidewalks to be decorated with **reddish tiles**.
text_zh: 在哥倫比亞，人行道用** reddish 磁磚**（紅褐色磁磚）裝飾的情況特別常見。

text: Coverage in Colombia is mainly found in the **north and west**. The islands of Providencia and San Andrés, northwest of the mainland, also have coverage.
text_zh: 哥倫比亞的街景覆蓋主要分佈在**北部與西部**。位於本土西北方的普羅維登西亞島（Providencia）與聖安德烈斯島（San Andrés）也有覆蓋。

text: The Northern part of the country is characterised by **white, sandy soil** and an arid landscape.
text_zh: 該國北部地區的特徵是**白色沙質土壤**與乾旱景觀。

text: East of the Andes lies a **vast lowland** called Llanos. It is characterised by open tropical grasslands, savannas with scattered trees, small areas of forest and seasonal flooding.
text_zh: 安地斯山脈以東坐落著一個稱為亞平斯平原（Llanos）的**廣闊低地**。其特徵為開闊的熱帶草原、散落著樹木的疏林草原、小面積森林以及季節性氾濫。

text: These pole markings with one short black strip on the top and bottom, and a **longer yellow section** in the middle, are most commonly found in the Antioquia department. Sometimes, you can find them in the Cordoba department as well.
text_zh: 這些電線桿標記在頂部和底部各有一條短黑條，中間則有一個**較長的黃色區段**，最常在安蒂奧基亞省（Antioquia）找到。有時，你也可以在科 Córdoba 省找到它們。

text: As a result of slave trade, the Pacific coast of Colombia is home to an overwhelming majority of **Afro-Colombians**.
text_zh: 由於奴隸貿易的歷史，哥倫比亞的太平洋沿岸是絕大多數**非裔哥倫比亞人**的家園。

text: **Sugar cane** is grown along the Cauca river in Valle del Cauca and neighbouring departments.
text_zh: **甘蔗**種植於考卡省的考卡河沿岸及鄰近省份。

text: A camera glitch that makes a part of the image look very saturated can be found in southern Colombia.
text_zh: 在哥倫比亞南部可以發現一種相機瑕疵，會讓部分的畫面看起來飽和度極高。

text: This landscape is typical of the far Northern province of La Guajira: **extreme dryness**, low vegetation and occasional cacti.
In addition, you can often recognise the Uribia-Puerto Bolivar road because of this landscape, the straightness and the train track always present to the East.
text_zh: 這種地貌是極北省份拉瓜希拉省的典型特徵：**極度乾旱**、植被稀疏且偶有仙人掌。
此外，你經常可以透過這種地景、筆直的道路，以及東側始終陪伴的鐵軌，來認出烏里比亞－波利瓦爾港（Uribia-Puerto Bolivar）公路。

text: You can recognise the narrow Ruta 90 landbridge between Barranquilla and Cienaga thanks to the dashed yellow lines and **shallow bodies of water** next to the road. [Open ocean](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xp7rvZ2T77oh1Cbu7) can often be seen to the north.
NOTE: In the older Generation 3 coverage, you will also see tall mountains in the distance.
text_zh: 你可以透過巴蘭幾亞（Barranquilla）和謝納加（Cienaga）之間狹窄的 90 號公路陸橋、虛線黃線，以及路旁**淺水水體**來認出這裡。北方經常可以看到[外海](https://maps.app.goo.gl/xp7rvZ2T77oh1Cbu7)。
注意：在較舊的第 3 代街景覆蓋中，你還會看到遠方的高山。

text: Intersections in the coastal city of Barranquilla are commonly marked by **small concrete poles** (_mojones_) bearing street names. For example, this image was taken at the intersection of Carrera 42 and Calle 68.
text_zh: 沿海城市巴蘭幾亞的十字路口通常有印著街道名稱的**小混凝土柱**（_mojones_）作標記。例如，這張照片是在卡雷拉 42 街（Carrera 42）和卡列 68 街（Calle 68）的交叉口拍攝的。

text: This **unique vehicle** can be found in and around Leticia, the Southernmost town in Colombia.
NOTE: The long concrete blocks seen in the bottom left corner are a reliable way of recognising the road North of Leticia.
text_zh: 這種**獨特車輛**可以在哥倫比亞最南端的城鎮萊蒂西亞（Leticia）及周邊地區找到。
注意：左下角看到的長條混凝土塊是認出萊蒂西亞以北道路的可靠方法。

text: Coverage on the Caribbean island of San Andrés was taken by this distinct **white car**.
text_zh: 加勒比海聖安德列斯島（San Andrés）上的街景覆蓋是由這輛獨特的**白色車**所拍攝。

text: The island of Providencia, located roughly 90 kilometres North of San Andrés, is home to this unique **grey truck**.
text_zh: 普羅維登西亞島（Providencia）位於聖安德列斯以北約 90 公里處，這輛獨特的**灰色卡車**就是這裡特有的。

text: Providencia **street lights** are green and supported by a trapezoidal sheet of metal underneath.

NOTE: The uniquely shaped [supporting metal](https://www.google.com/maps/@10.9825784,-74.7938269,3a,15.1y,9.87h,107.69t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sT2K_vf3jLCcKNBdRfnFTbA!2e0!5s20221001T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) piece can also be found in Barranquilla.
text_zh: 普羅維登西亞島的**街燈**是綠色的，下方由一塊梯形金屬板支撐。
注意：這個形狀獨特的[支撐金屬](https://www.google.com/maps/@10.9825784,-74.7938269,3a,15.1y,9.87h,107.69t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sT2K_vf3jLCcKNBdRfnFTbA!2e0!5s20221001T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)零件也可以在巴蘭幾亞找到。
